scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'); http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = req.url === '/' ? '/index.html' : req.url; try { res.end(fs.readFileSync('.' + p)); } catch(e) { res.statusCode = 404; res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(3000, () => console.log('Dev server running on http://localhost:3000'));"
